item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"piece_id":"01","ready":false,"issues":["c1 locator does not support the stated two-part mass-check method; it only says Backflip “got it exactly correct.”","c4 locator supports structured BOM output but not the claimed missing/unrecognized-part flags or estimator review.","c6 omits the segment supporting the claimed full simulated sequence.","Argument is a broad, untyped inference combining several producers rather than a narrowly stated inference claim with focused evidence.","Synthesis combines Backflip, Autodesk, Cableteque, and NVIDIA observations under one uncited catch-all conclusion instead of separating each producer fact and a narrowly worded inference.","The central claim that AI is moving into governed workflows overstates the evidence: the cited vendor demonstrations and claims do not establish governance, review routing, or dependable workflow adoption.","The draft lacks a separately typed inference that connects the evidence while preserving each producer’s reported fact as a separate claim."]}
